<thought>We have located the training and test CSV files needed for model training. Using the provided hyperparameters, we will train an XGBoost regression model to predict the formation_energy_per_atom target and save the model checkpoint to the designated output directory.</thought>
<action>train_xgboost_model</action>
<action_input>{
    "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_6/oxide_ml_dataset/train.csv",
    "test_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/0_prepare_ml_ready_dataset_trial_6/oxide_ml_dataset/test.csv",
    "model_save_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/WORKDIR/6/1_train_xgboost_formation_energy_model_trial_10/trained_xgboost_model.pkl",
    "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "hyperparameters": {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1
    }
}</action_input>
